item.title: Topics in Environmental Economics
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of the Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance invites research on various aspects of environmental economics. The issue seeks to bring together scholarly work examining the economic dimensions of environmental challenges and solutions, including policy approaches, market mechanisms, and theoretical frameworks addressing environmental sustainability and resource management.

Appel publié par The Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Environmental economics
  • Sustainability
  • Climate change economics
  • Resource management
  • Pollution economics
  • Green economics
  • Environmental policy
  • Ecosystem services
  • Carbon pricing
  • Renewable energy economics

Timeline

  • April 30, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: Electoral Competition, Voting, Political Violence, and Policy Outcomes
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of The Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance focuses on the intersection of economics and politics, examining how electoral competition, voting mechanisms, political violence, and policy outcomes interact to shape economic and political systems.

Appel publié par The Quarterly Review of Economics and Finance. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Electoral competition
  • Voting behavior and analysis
  • Political violence
  • Policy outcomes
  • Economics of politics

Timeline

  • April 1, 2026: Full paper submission deadline
